# Foyr

> > Foyr is a comprehensive 3D home design and interior design platform combining AI-powered tools, photorealistic rendering, and professional visualization services.

Foyr offers both free and premium browser-based design software (Foyr Neo) alongside AI-powered design generation (Ideate) and professional services. The platform serves interior designers, homeowners, and e-commerce businesses with tools for floor planning, 3D visualization, mood boarding, and virtual staging.

## Key Topics

- Foyr Neo
- 3D rendering
- Interior design software

- Photorealistic rendering

## Core Products

- [Foyr Neo Interior Design Software](https://foyr.com/neo-interior-design-software): Browser-based interior design software with 3D rendering, CAD tools, and AI-powered features for professional designers and homeowners
- [Ideate AI Interior Design Generator](https://foyr.com/ideate-ai-interior-design-generator): AI-powered interior design generator for virtual staging, room visualization, and instant design concepts
- [Foyr Moodboard Creator](https://foyr.com/mood-board-creator): Free online AI-powered mood board creator with templates and design tools for inspiration gathering
- [Foyr Pricing](https://foyr.com/pricing): Flexible subscription plans with render credits and tiers for different design professionals

## Professional Services

- [Interior Design Services](https://foyr.com/interior-design-services): Professional interior design services including virtual design, commercial projects, and floor plan creation
- [3D Furniture Rendering Services](https://foyr.com/enterprise/3d-furniture-rendering-services): Enterprise-grade 3D furniture rendering and visualization services for e-commerce and product visualization

## Inspiration & Galleries

- [Interior Design Ideas](https://foyr.com/interior-design-ideas): Design inspiration gallery with thousands of interior design projects and professional work examples
- [Floor Plan Gallery](https://foyr.com/floor-plan-gallery): 2D/3D residential and apartment layout templates for floor plan inspiration and reference

## Learning & Guides

- [Learn With Foyr](https://foyr.com/learn): Learning hub with interior design guides, 3D modeling tutorials, and design inspiration resources
- [How to Design Your Dream Home](https://foyr.com/learn/how-to-design-your-dream-home): 10-step guide to designing a house covering planning, budgeting, and software best practices
- [2-Bedroom House Plans & Costs](https://foyr.com/learn/2-bedroom-house-plan): Comprehensive guide to 2-bedroom house plans with designs, costs, and 3D visualization techniques
- [3D Virtual House Tours](https://foyr.com/learn/virtual-house-tours): Guide to creating 3D virtual house tours using VR/AR technology for client presentations
- [Smart Home Automation Devices](https://foyr.com/learn/top-smart-home-automation-devices): Comprehensive guide to smart home automation devices and IoT gadgets for modern homes
